# Nikoui and Associates

> Premier forensic investigation and identification services specializing in fingerprint analysis, DNA processing, crime scene investigation, and expert witness testimony.

Nikoui and Associates is a team of certified forensic specialists led by founder Kouroush Nikoui, offering comprehensive forensic identification services to legal professionals, law enforcement, and investigative agencies. The firm combines advanced biometric technologies like AFIS with traditional forensic expertise across multiple disciplines.

## Key Topics

- Fingerprint Analysis
- DNA Processing and Recovery
- Crime Scene Investigation
- Forensic Photography
- Document Examination
- Footwear Impression Analysis
- AFIS and Biometrics
- Expert Witness Services
- Forensic Identification
- Kouroush Nikoui
- Michael Stapleton
- Ben Bavarian
- John Calvin Gaziano
- SWGFAST Standards
- Signature Authentication

## Core Services

- [Fingerprint Pattern Comparison & Identification](https://www.nikouiandassociates.com/fingerprint-pattern-comparison-identification): Fingerprint analysis, comparison, and identification services
- [Crime Scene Investigation & Case Review](https://www.nikouiandassociates.com/crime-scene-investigation-case-review): Crime scene investigation and case review services for legal professionals
- [Fingerprint Analysis, DNA Processing & Recovery](https://www.nikouiandassociates.com/fingerprint-analysis-dna-processing-recovery): Fingerprint and DNA processing and recovery forensic services
- [AFIS & Biometrics Services](https://www.nikouiandassociates.com/afis-biometrics): AFIS and biometric services for forensic identification
- [Document Examination & Analysis](https://www.nikouiandassociates.com/document-examination-analysis-services): Document examination, forgery detection, and signature authentication
- [Footwear Impression Evidence Analysis](https://www.nikouiandassociates.com/footwear-impression-evidence-comparison-identification): Footwear impression evidence analysis and shoe print examination
- [Forensic Photography Services](https://www.nikouiandassociates.com/forensic-photography): Forensic photography for evidence documentation and court presentation
